name: Connecticut Department of Housing
handles: Finances housing construction and infrastructure and assists residents and municipalities with housing subsidies, including rental assistance programs.
complaint_process: Contact DOH by phone for its housing programs; for a housing crisis, the department directs residents to call 211.
evidence: DOH supports Connecticut residents by financing housing construction and infrastructure.

name: Connecticut Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities (CHRO)
handles: Enforces Connecticut civil and human rights laws and takes discrimination complaints in employment, housing, public accommodations, and credit.
complaint_process: File a notarized complaint with a CHRO regional office or schedule an intake appointment, within 300 days of the discriminatory act.
evidence: injustices in employment, housing, places of public accommodations, or in credit transactions

name: Connecticut Department of Public Health (DPH)
handles: Oversees public health and licenses healthcare facilities, taking complaints about care in licensed healthcare facilities.
complaint_process: Submit a facility care complaint through the DPH Facility Licensing and Investigations Section online form at dphflisevents.ct.gov/Complaints.
evidence: The Department of Public Health (DPH) supports CT providers and individuals.

name: Connecticut Office of the Healthcare Advocate (OHA)
handles: Provides free help to consumers understanding their health benefits and advocates for them when benefits are denied.
complaint_process: Request help through the OHA online inquiry form, by email, or by phone; an advocate responds within 1-2 business days.
evidence: advocates for consumers when their benefits are denied

name: Connecticut Insurance Department
handles: Makes sure insurance companies follow state law and treat consumers fairly, and accepts consumer insurance complaints.
complaint_process: File an insurance complaint through the Department's online complaint page or call Consumer Affairs.
evidence: making sure that insurance companies follow the state's laws and treat you fairly

name: Connecticut Department of Social Services (DSS)
handles: Administers benefits including SNAP food assistance, HUSKY (Medicaid) health coverage, and cash help.
complaint_process: Apply for or renew benefits online through MyAccount at connect.ct.gov, or call the Benefits Center.

name: Connecticut State Department of Education (CSDE)
handles: Serves as the administrative arm of the State Board of Education, including the Bureau of Special Education and its due process unit.
complaint_process: Special education complaints go to the Bureau of Special Education Due Process Unit (Dueprocess.sde@ct.gov, 860-713-6966).
evidence: the administrative arm of the Connecticut State Board of Education

name: Connecticut Department of Transportation (CTDOT)
handles: Is responsible for Connecticut's major transportation systems and takes reports of problems on state roads.
complaint_process: Report a problem on a state road through the CTDOT online customer care webform or by phone.
address: 2800 Berlin Turnpike, P.O. Box 317546, Newington, CT 06131-7546
evidence: We're responsible for Connecticut's major transportation systems

name: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection (DEEP)
handles: Conserves and protects the state's natural resources and environment and takes reports of pollution and environmental problems.
complaint_process: Report environmental emergencies 24 hours a day at 866-337-7745; use DEEP's topic-specific online complaint forms for other pollution concerns.
evidence: dedicated to conserving, improving, and protecting our natural resources and the environment

name: Connecticut Office of the Attorney General
handles: Accepts consumer complaints and may provide informal mediation to help consumers resolve issues with businesses.
complaint_process: File an electronic complaint at www.dir.ct.gov/ag/complaint/; PDF forms are available in other languages.
evidence: File an electronic complaint with the Office of the Attorney General.

name: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection (DCP)
handles: Protects consumers from fraud and unfair business practices and takes complaints about businesses, including home improvement contractors.
complaint_process: Submit a complaint to DCP online or by mail, email, or fax, with copies of receipts and paperwork.
evidence: protect Connecticut citizens from fraud, unfair business practices

name: Connecticut Department of Labor (CTDOL)
handles: Runs the state unemployment insurance program through the ReEmployCT system, including new claims, weekly certifications, and appeals.
complaint_process: File a new unemployment claim and weekly certifications online through ReEmployCT, or submit a case online.
evidence: File your first claim to begin receiving benefits

name: Connecticut General Assembly - Find Your Legislators
handles: Lets residents look up their state legislators by town and street address.
address: Legislative Office Building, 300 Capitol Avenue, Hartford, CT 06106
